Reviewed both real stateful/runtime classes and every method; corrected the framework description parameter, removed an unused alternate schema formatter and preserved async response/collector protocols.
changes: Renamed BaseAgent constructor agent_id parameter to description and updated all seven concrete subclasses; actual framework descriptions are unchanged.
Removed unused format_schema_as_markdown after checking source, tests, examples, scripts and docs; DDL and service prompt formatting remain at their actual callers.

removed_definitions.name: BaseAgent.format_schema_as_markdown
removed_definitions.reason: DES-001: No registered callback, direct caller, test or documentation reference consumed this duplicate formatter.
notes: DES-001: No registered callback, direct caller, test or documentation reference consumed this duplicate formatter.

definitions.name: BaseAgent
definitions.declared_role: 所有智能体的基类，提供共享功能
notes: CLS-001/FUN-005: RoutedAgent base owns actual model/dialect/display-name/schema state and shared response/memory adapters used by seven concrete registered agents.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.__init__
notes: NAM-001/CLS-002: The former agent_id value is actually AutoGen's description; renamed it to description and passed it by that keyword, preserving all existing string values and runtime-assigned identities.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.final_text
definitions.declared_role: SQL/prompts require a final text message, not a tool or runtime event.
notes: FUN-001/CLS-004: Private-to-capability static SDK-result adapter requires a final TextMessage with nonempty content; tool/runtime events cannot silently become SQL or explanation text.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.send_response
definitions.declared_role: 发送响应消息到流输出主题
notes: FUN-005: Async runtime publication preserves ResponseMessage source/content/final/result fields and the current stream topic/source identity.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.send_error
notes: FUN-005: Shared async failure action logs the concrete agent error and publishes an explicit final error response.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.handle_exception
definitions.declared_role: 处理异常并发送错误消息
notes: ERR-003/FUN-005: Preserves the original exception traceback in logging and emits the existing error message through the actual response protocol.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.format_schema_context
definitions.declared_role: 将表结构信息格式化为SQL DDL字符串
notes: CLS-004/FUN-001: Actual query-analysis/explanation callers use this DDL-style schema representation; it retains the supported empty-schema mode and required populated metadata fields.

definitions.name: BaseAgent.rebuild_memory_from_content

files.summary: Read the full package initializer: documentation only, with no classes, functions, lambdas, wildcard imports or runtime resource creation. Retained the package marker for its actual runtime/capability grouping.

definitions.name: AgentStatus
notes: NAM-006: Enum describes the bus-agent lifecycle states consumed by dispatch and health/status methods.

definitions.name: AgentBase

definitions.name: AgentBase.__init__
notes: CLS-002: Creates independent per-agent state, metrics and lock and makes the optional bus attachment explicit until controller assembly.

definitions.name: AgentBase.initialize
notes: FUN-005: Async registry lifecycle hook applies configuration and returns the existing boolean initialization outcome; failure changes the visible status to ERROR.

definitions.name: AgentBase.process

definitions.name: AgentBase.send_message

definitions.name: AgentBase.subscribe_to_messages

definitions.name: AgentBase.__repr__

definitions.name: AgentMasterController.start

definitions.name: AgentMasterController._route_to_agent

definitions.name: AgentMasterController.create_workflow_from_config

definitions.name: AgentMasterController.get_system_status

definitions.name: AgentMasterController.save_config

definitions.name: AgentInfo

definitions.name: AgentInfo.__init__

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.__init__

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.register

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.unregister

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.create_instance
notes: RES-001/CLS-002: Per-identity lock prevents duplicate construction; initialization and registration/enabled rechecks precede publication, and failed/cancelled partial instances are cleaned in finally.

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.get_instance
notes: FUN-005: Existing asynchronous registry lookup protocol is used throughout the orchestrator/controller; absence returns None without secretly constructing an instance.

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.get_agent_info

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.list_agent_ids

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.list_agents
notes: FUN-001: Applies the optional actual AgentType filter and enabled_only mode against identity-keyed registrations.

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.enable_agent

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.disable_agent

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.is_enabled

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.get_dependencies

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.validate_dependencies

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.create_dependency_chain
notes: FUN-001: Owns dependency traversal state and returns initialized instances in dependency order, with cycles/unavailable/failed initialization remaining visible errors.

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.create_dependency_chain.visit

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.get_stats
notes: FUN-001: Reports actual registration/enabled/instance/type-index counts without changing registry state.

definitions.name: AgentRegistry.shutdown_all

files.summary: Reviewed message construction/roundtrip/replies, nested defaultdict and response callbacks, worker tasks, routing and history; renamed the handler adapter to describe invocation rather than unimplemented safety.

notes: NAM-001: The adapter performs invocation/awaiting; error handling is owned by dispatch.

definitions.name: Message
notes: CLS-001: Represents the bus runtime's mutable message identity/correlation/reply metadata; it is distinct from the policy runtime AgentMessage schema.

definitions.name: Message.__init__
notes: CLS-002: Initializes actual ID/timestamp/type/content/sender/recipient and per-message metadata; None recipient retains the real broadcast mode.

definitions.name: Message.to_dict
notes: FUN-001: Serializes all identity, enum, payload, timestamp and reply/correlation fields into the established wire representation.

definitions.name: Message.from_dict
notes: CLS-004: Classmethod constructs through cls and restores required ID/timestamp plus genuinely optional correlation/recipient fields; required malformed data fails visibly.

definitions.name: Message.create_reply
notes: FUN-001: Creates a directed reply, copies metadata and preserves original correlation/reply identity rather than treating replies as new unrelated requests.

definitions.name: Message.__repr__

definitions.name: MessageBus
definitions.declared_role: 消息总线 - 实现Agent间的消息传递
notes: CLS-001/ASY-006: Owns queue/backpressure, subscriber indexes, worker tasks, statistics and bounded history; sync and async subscriber modes are actual supported behavior.

definitions.name: MessageBus.__init__
notes: CLS-002: Creates independent subscriber maps, queue, task list and history/stats for the bus instance.

definitions.name: MessageBus.__init__.<lambda>@95:92
notes: FUN-005/CLS-005: defaultdict factory creates a fresh per-agent message-type subscription map; the lambda prevents different agents sharing mutable subscriber lists.

definitions.name: MessageBus.start
notes: ASY-006: Starts and retains actual worker task handles once; a running bus does not spawn duplicate workers.

definitions.name: MessageBus.stop
notes: ASY-005/ASY-009: Stops dispatch, cancels the owned workers and waits for their completion with bounded cleanup before clearing handles.

definitions.name: MessageBus.subscribe
notes: FUN-005: Registers a callable under the real global or agent-scoped message-type index and avoids duplicate callback subscriptions.

definitions.name: MessageBus.unsubscribe
notes: FUN-005: Removes the same callable from the matching subscription scope; this exact inverse is used by temporary request callbacks.

definitions.name: MessageBus.publish
notes: ASY-001: Awaits Queue.put for real backpressure, then updates sent count/history; no speculative QueueFull fallback is introduced.

definitions.name: MessageBus.request
notes: RES-002/ASY-005: Owns a temporary response future/subscription and always unsubscribes in finally, including timeout and cancellation; actual timeout returns None.

definitions.name: MessageBus.request.response_handler
notes: FUN-005: Nested synchronous callback captures this request's future and reply_to identity and avoids setting an already-completed future.

definitions.name: MessageBus._worker
definitions.declared_role: 工作进程 - 处理消息队列
notes: ASY-006: Owned worker waits for messages and guarantees task_done in a finally around dispatch; ordinary handler failures are logged while cancellation propagates.

definitions.name: MessageBus._dispatch_message
notes: FUN-001/ASY-006: Combines actual global/directed/broadcast subscriptions, deduplicates callbacks, awaits all handler tasks and tracks delivered versus failed outcomes.

definitions.name: MessageBus._invoke_handler
definitions.declared_role: Invoke a registered handler and await its result when it is asynchronous.
notes: NAM-001/FUN-005: Renamed from _safe_call_handler because it invokes a registered sync or async callable and deliberately lets errors reach the dispatch owner's result handling.

definitions.name: MessageBus._record_message
notes: FUN-001: Records by message identity and evicts the oldest retained entry after the explicit history bound.

definitions.name: MessageBus.get_stats
notes: FUN-001: Reports actual queued/history/subscriber counts across both subscription scopes and accumulated delivery outcomes.

definitions.name: MessageBus.get_message

files.summary: Reviewed all processor methods, nested reader callback, and six provider contracts. Retain the stateful processor and its synchronous worker boundaries; remove repeated input-shape guessing after Pydantic normalization.
changes: NAM-003/NAM-005: group standard-library, third-party, and project imports at module scope.
ASY-007: use asyncio.to_thread for the LlamaIndex reader worker; rename/type the nested callback.
DAT-001/FUN-004: retain validated MinerUExtractedFile between polling and extraction instead of dumping/reprobing dicts.
ERR-001/RES-001: read nested full.md preferentially and reject invalid UTF-8 in ZIP text.
FUN-001: remove unsupported binary DOC advertisement/mapping; DOCX and other actual engines remain.
CLS-004: make the pure text-file async conversion static.
limitations: At the user's request, no tests, lint, build, compile, application imports, service starts, browser actions, or application API requests were run. AST parsing was used only to inventory source definitions.
Binary DOC was already unparseable by DocxReader; these parsers now report only supported formats. Source-workspace upload support is a separate interface and was not removed.
Provider HTTP behavior and reader execution were not exercised.

renamed_definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_with_llamaindex._process_with_llamaindex
notes: The nested worker remains a genuine callback; name and Optional[str] contract now describe its actual document-read result.

definitions.name: MinerUEnvelope
notes: PYD/FUN-003: retain the explicit provider envelope; nonzero codes are handled before optional data is validated.

definitions.name: MinerUUploadSlot
notes: PYD/DAT-001: batch_id and at least one upload URL are required at the HTTP boundary; retain this separate wire contract.

definitions.name: MinerUMarkdownContent
notes: PYD/DES-004: aliases describe the existing provider's actual text fields and are normalized once; optional text permits archive-only results.

definitions.name: MinerUExtractedFile
notes: PYD/DAT-002: a pending task may lack text/archive/error fields, while echoed data_id and state are required.

definitions.name: MinerUBatchFiles
notes: PYD/DAT-001: validate every response entry before polling inspects state; an empty list remains a valid pending batch.

definitions.name: MinerUMetadata
notes: ERR-004: optional metadata is a separate response contract; a failed enrichment is not an empty document extraction.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor
definitions.declared_role: 增强文档处理器 - 支持多种文档解析引擎
notes: CLS-001/DES-003: retain the class because enabled parser modes, reader instances, credentials, and timeout settings are shared across methods; no generic factory is needed.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor.__init__
notes: CLS-002/DAT-003: preserve explicit empty configuration, resolve settings at construction, and initialize only enabled readers; removed the invalid DOC-to-DocxReader mapping.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor.extract_text
notes: FUN-001/FUN-003: suffix dispatch keeps the str/Path boundary used by API callers; unsupported formats raise, and no extracted text remains Optional[str].

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_from_pdf
definitions.declared_role: 从PDF提取文本 - 多引擎支持
notes: ERR-001/DES-004: selected parser failure propagates; retain real MinerU-versus-LlamaIndex modes without silently trying another engine.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_with_mineru
notes: ASY-001/ASY-007: this short wrapper is necessary to keep requests, polling sleeps, and ZIP reads off the event loop; to_thread carries caller context.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_with_mineru_sync
definitions.declared_role: 使用 MinerU 在线接口：申请上传 → PUT 文件 → 提交解析 → 拉取结果
notes: FUN-002: keep the upload-slot, upload, poll, and extract sequence together within one worker; missing credentials/content raise explicitly.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_with_llamaindex
notes: ASY-001/ASY-007: changed run_in_executor/get_event_loop to the existing to_thread pattern so the synchronous reader inherits context.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._extract_with_llamaindex.read_documents
notes: FUN-005/FUN-004: retain the nested worker closure because it captures the selected path/reader; give it a concrete Optional[str] result and use the already-supported suffix directly.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._mineru_headers
notes: CLS-004: retain an instance method because it uses the configured API key; it returns the exact API-header mapping and does not configure signed object-storage requests.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._mineru_request_upload_link
definitions.declared_role: 申请 MinerU 上传地址，返回 (upload_url, batch_id, data_id)。
notes: DAT-001/RES-001: validate the envelope and upload-slot fields before use, close the response, and return the concrete upload URL/batch/data identifiers.

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._mineru_upload_file

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._mineru_poll_batch_result

definitions.name: EnhancedDocumentProcessor._mineru_extract_markdown

files.summary: Reviewed the complete loader facade and every extraction/inference method. Keep the facade's shared format policy; mark pure file/text transformations as static methods and preserve the streaming/list entry points.
changes: CLS-004: mark thirteen pure extraction/inference methods static without changing their instance-call syntax.
FUN-004: add the streaming iterator and constructor return annotations.
DAT-003: prevent coarse month extraction from overwriting a precise parsed date.
DES-001: remove unused date-format tuple fields and redundant set conversions for fixed unique keyword lists.
FUN-001/NAM-005: advertise only implemented extraction formats and group imports.
limitations: At the user's request, no tests, lint, build, compile, application imports, service starts, browser actions, or application API requests were run. AST parsing was used only to inventory source definitions.
The geographic/department/date extractors are existing heuristics; this audit does not replace them with a new NLP algorithm.
Legacy .doc input needs a parser that actually supports binary DOC; it is no longer included in this loader's advertised formats.

definitions.name: AGModule
notes: CLS-001/005: 基类共享 Agent 身份与启停状态，handle 是三个实际示例子类采用的异步协议，不是无状态 Helper。

definitions.name: AGModule.__init__
notes: CLS-002: 保存必需 name/agent_type 与实例启用状态，不猜默认资源或启动服务。

definitions.name: AGModule.handle
definitions.declared_role: 处理数据的抽象方法，子类必须实现
notes: FUN-005: 明确的子类异步处理协议；基类未实现时直接抛出 NotImplementedError，不返回默认成功。

definitions.name: AGModule.start
notes: FUN-005/CLS-003: 保留现有异步启停协议并只改变该 Agent 实例的活动状态。

definitions.name: AGModule.stop
notes: FUN-005/CLS-003: 停止当前实例并记录状态，调用方仍按同一异步生命周期清理。

definitions.name: AGMessageBus
notes: CLS-001: 队列与订阅者是消息总线真实共享状态，与顺序工作流职责不同，保持同一示例文件中的独立类。

definitions.name: AGMessageBus.__init__
notes: CLS-002/005: 每个消息总线独立创建队列和订阅表，不共享可变默认值。

definitions.name: AGMessageBus.publish
notes: FUN-001/ERR: 顺序入队后通知各订阅者；单订阅者失败带堆栈可见并继续其他订阅者，保留既有广播契约。

definitions.name: AGMessageBus.subscribe
notes: FUN-001: 在实际主题列表登记回调，不构造注册框架或做输入形态猜测。

definitions.name: AGMessageBus.get
notes: FUN-001/005: 返回消息或真实的短轮询超时 None；仅捕获 TimeoutError，其他错误保持可见。

definitions.name: AGBuilder
notes: CLS-001: Agent 注册表、工作流定义与运行状态是实际共享状态；不把示例类移进生产包或拆成更多文件。

definitions.name: AGBuilder.__init__
notes: CLS-002/005: 初始化每实例 Agent、工作流和消息队列，无导入阶段工作。

definitions.name: AGBuilder.register

definitions.name: AGBuilder.create_workflow

definitions.name: AGBuilder.run_workflow

files.summary: 审阅 Agent pack、外部模型、DSL 与规则边界的行为断言；同步纯计算的同步接口和提示词命名。
changes: 移除测试和数据夹具名称中的历史 round4_ 前缀。
同步提示词常量/构建函数、纯比较/质量/综合函数同步调用和 _generate_with_llm 的真实参数。
根据 DSL 源码审查增加数值/布尔边界、严格 JSON、时窗、YAML/最小保存、原子失败与符号链接、空表格列和档位端点回归；均未执行。
增加外部模板引号/换行/分类限额往返，以及 ConsumerCouponSchema 的 AMOUNT/PERCENT 与商户场景分工回归。
limitations: 按用户要求仅审阅源码并生成 AST 定义清单；未运行测试、lint、构建、compile、应用导入、服务、浏览器、API 或数据写入脚本。
符号链接回归在未来 Windows 主机返回权限错误 1314 时按明确环境限制跳过；本轮未尝试创建链接。
